
### P4 switch architecture 


::: {.r-stack .my-full .top}
![](/switches/texfig/p4arch.figure-1.svg){.fragment .fade-out fragment-index=2 fig-alt="diagram showing (from left to right) for 'in' ports, directed into four queues (stacked vertically), followed by a tall box to the right of the queues labeled 'parser', then tall box labeled 'inegress', then tall box labled 'deparser', then another stack of four queues, then another box labeled 'parser', a box labeled 'egress', then a box labeled 'deparser', then another stack of four queues, each of which goes to a 'out' port."}

![](/switches/texfig/p4arch.figure-2.svg){.fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=2 fig-alt="same diagram, but all three stacks of queues are highlighted."}

![](/switches/texfig/p4arch.figure-3.svg){.fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=3 fig-alt="same diagram, but the first set of boxes (parser, ingress, deparser), and the second set of boxes (parser, egress, deparser) are marked as two separate entities."}

![](/switches/texfig/p4arch.figure-4.svg){.fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=4 fig-alt="same diagram, but the first set of boxes (parser, ingress, deparser) only is highlighted."}

![](/switches/texfig/p4arch.figure-5.svg){.fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=5 fig-alt="same diagram, but the second set of boxes (parser, egress, deparser) only is highlighted."}

![](/switches/texfig/p4arch.figure-6.svg){.fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=6 fig-alt="same diagram, but the two 'parser' boxes are highlighted (one is after the input queue before ingress processing, the other is after the second of queues before egress processing)"}

![](/switches/texfig/p4arch.figure-7.svg){.fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=7 fig-alt="same daigram, but the two 'deparser' boxes are highlighted."}

![](/switches/texfig/p4arch.figure-8.svg){.fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=8 fig-alt="same diagram, but the 'ingress' and 'egress' boxes are highlighted."}


:::

::: {.myoverbox .vlow .fragment fragment-index=2 .fade-in-then-out}

* queues of frames to be processed

* holds packets in between processing steps (if needed)

:::

::: {.myoverbox .vlow .fragment fragment-index=3 .fade-in-then-out}

<i>ingress</i> and <i>egress</i> pipelines

:::

::: {.myoverbox .vlow .fragment fragment-index=4 .fade-in-then-out}

* ingress pipeline: processes every input frame
* primary job: decide where to forward frame (if anywhere)

:::

::: {.myoverbox .vlow .fragment fragment-index=5 .fade-in-then-out}

* egress pipeline: processes every output frame
* runs one time for _each copy_ output

:::

::: {.myoverbox .vlow .fragment fragment-index=6 .fade-in-then-out}

* parser: decode frames fields into temporary storage

:::

::: {.myoverbox .vlow .fragment fragment-index=7 .fade-in-then-out}

* deparser: convert decoded fields back into bytes for network

:::

::: {.myoverbox .vlow .fragment fragment-index=8 .fade-in-then-out}

*  "match/action pipelines"

*  do a series of table lookups based on parsed fields

*  each table lookup specifes next action

:::


### P4: switch parts  {.smaller}


```
V1Switch(
MyParser(),
MyVerifyChecksum(),
MyIngress(),
MyEgress(),
MyComputeChecksum(),
MyDeparser()
) main;

```
 

* code to declare instance of dataplane from functions for each part
* will look at most of these components 

   * won't have reason to change verify/compute checksum
